task: Prevent subjective studio candidates from being promoted by machine evidence alone

contract: A subjective candidate marked requires_human_review cannot become accepted while listening status is pending.
Explicit human acceptance is required in addition to a passing machine gate.
Human acceptance cannot override machine safety or protected-metric regressions.
Human rejection keeps the candidate rejected.
Non-subjective candidates preserve the existing machine-gate behavior.

current_cleanup_baseline.note: Balance-transparent Ptitsa cleanup remains machine-valid but is not an accepted studio baseline until human listening accepts RAW vs CLEAN, with special attention to both vocals.

next_studio_goal.task: Strengthen Perceptual Critic evidence/uncertainty output so Autonomous Iteration can distinguish machine-safe, human-pending and rejected subjective candidates without conflating those states.
